newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESTONIA-LIVIKO PRIVATISATION PLAN TO BE APPROVED.
newsitem.headline: ESTONIA-LIVIKO PRIVATISATION PLAN TO BE APPROVED.

text.p: The government may at its evening session approve the privatisation plan of Estonia's largest alcohol producer, Liviko, Economy Minister Jaak Leimann said on Tuesday.
Leimann told a news conference that according to the plan, 44 percent of the company's shares will be privatised in a public offer this year.
Next year, some 30 percent of its shares will be sold in an offering with preliminary negotiations and a further 21 percent in a public offer.
"Liviko should be privatised by the end of next year," Leimann said.
The privatisation agency last year sold five percent of its shares, which are traded actively on the OTC market.
